entries.name: game_hud_stats
entries.title: Stats
entries.description: Exp/h, raw exp/h, DPS, HPS, MPS, damage, kills and graphs.

entries.name: game_autoloot
entries.title: Autoloot
entries.description: Loot lists with item search, NPC prices and gold per oz, Add by value, and right-click any item to add or remove it from autoloot.

entries.name: game_loot_tracker
entries.title: Autoloot tracker
entries.description: Items the server loots, counts, NPC value per item and total. Right-click a row to remove it from autoloot or copy its name or id.

entries.name: game_player_info
entries.title: Player info
entries.description: Other players shown inline as [RP 250] Name, in the name's own health colour. Copy Name, VIP, private messages and the battle list all still see the real name.

entries.name: game_exiva
entries.title: Exiva
entries.description: Exiva replies drawn on the minimap and at the screen edge.

entries.name: game_pos_hud
entries.title: Position HUD
entries.description: Your x, y, z at the top-right corner of the minimap.

entries.name: game_better_chat
entries.title: Better chat
entries.description: Split view beside the chat with coloured [!] filter tabs.

entries.name: game_save_now
entries.title: Save now
entries.description: Save settings, hotkeys, layout and bot storage without exiting.

entries.name: game_buttons_fit
entries.title: Buttons panel fit
entries.description: Grows the Buttons panel so every button row stays visible.

entries.name: game_module_installer
entries.title: Module installer
entries.description: Lists the published modules, installs and updates them, search included.

entries.name: game_top_buttons
entries.title: Better top buttons
entries.description: One collapsible panel listing every top button as icon + name. Three tiers per button: Fav keeps it in the old grid, List shows it in the panel, Off hides it.

entries.name: game_online_hud
entries.title: Players online
entries.description: Shows the !online player count under FPS/Ping. Click to refresh, right-click to pause the 2 minute auto refresh.
